title: Assistant Professor of Business Administration
bio: Finalist for the 2025 INFORMS Society of Location Analysis (SOLA) Best Student Paper Award for “When Where Watt: Harnessing the Value of Time and Location for Renewable Electricity Generation” with Vishrut Rana and Serguei Netessine.

Kaps' research focuses on emerging topics in renewable electricity generation and storage - notably how new technologies, sustainability behavior, and policies shape the energy market of the future.
